description: DACULA, GA — Former State Representative Farooq Mughal is calling for a responsible and balanced approach to the rapid expansion of data centers across Georgia, supporting a temporary moratorium on new data center construction until stronger safeguards are in place to protect Georgia families, natural resources, and the state’s long-term energy future.“As technology continues to grow, we must make sure that economic development does not come at the expense of working families, our environment, o
title: Former State Representative Farooq Mughal Calls for Responsible Approach to Data Center Growth, Supports Temporary Moratorium on New Construction
